notes: אֵיבַת עוֹלָם is an adverbial accusative, so its supplied with goes to the noun whose case-function licenses it rather than being added (rule 33), and the rectum is rendered attributively as perpetual (rule 28).
יַעַן takes Because alone here: unlike EZK.25.8 and EZK.25.12 the ASV writes no that beside it.

יִּנָּקְמוּ keeps its head on taken rather than on vengeance, because the cognate accusative נָקָם is its own source token and rule 44's light-verb clause cannot reach a complement another morpheme licenses.
The בְּ of בְּנֶפֶשׁ is what the ASV renders of, as at EZK.25.6.
